placeholders.title: We're using Tailwind instead of styled-components
placeholders.context: Faster prototyping, the team already knows it, smaller bundle

placeholders.title: API pagination will use cursors, not offsets
placeholders.context: Better performance at scale, no skipped items when data changes

placeholders.title: Onboarding checklist replaces the product tour
placeholders.context: Few people finished the tour. A checklist lets them go at their own pace

placeholders.title: Mobile-first design for all new pages
placeholders.context: Most traffic is mobile, and desktop layouts adapt more easily than the reverse

placeholders.title: No custom date picker, we use the native input
placeholders.context: Saves two weeks of work, and native pickers are good enough now

placeholders.title: Pricing page shows annual billing by default
placeholders.context: Most customers pick annual anyway, monthly stays one click away

placeholders.title: Ship weekly instead of every two weeks
placeholders.context: Smaller releases, faster feedback, easier rollbacks

placeholders.title: Design tokens live in CSS custom properties
placeholders.context: No runtime cost, no flash of unstyled content, simpler theming
